articles.title: Microsoft Fixes 1,118 Vulnerabilities in October Patch Tuesday and Introduces New Risk Cohorts
articles.summary:
Microsoft’s October 2026 Patch Tuesday briefing outlines 1,118 vulnerabilities across 15 risk groups, alongside a new approach designed to help security teams review large update releases. Called risk cohorts, these groups bring together flaws that require similar questions about an organization’s systems, users, and exposure. Microsoft’s accompanying document maps individual CVEs to these shared areas […]

articles.title: Critical FortiSandbox GUI Vulnerability Allows Remote Attackers to Bypass Authentication
articles.summary:
Fortinet disclosed a critical authentication-bypass vulnerability in the FortiSandbox graphical user interface that could let remote attackers access protected functions without valid credentials. Tracked as CVE-2026-107656, the flaw carries a reported CVSSv3 score of 9.6 and affects both FortiSandbox appliances and selected FortiSandbox PaaS releases. articles.title: TFG London Cyberattack Disrupts IT Systems Used by Phase Eight, Hobbs, and Whistles Brands
articles.summary:
TFG London has confirmed a cyberattack that disrupted IT systems supporting Phase Eight, Hobbs, and Whistles. South Africa’s The Foschini Group detected the incident on October 11, 2026, and disclosed it to shareholders on October 13. Several systems remained unavailable, although stores continued trading. articles.title: Critical Docker Hub Flaw Lets Attackers Impersonate Users and Push Container Images
articles.summary:
Docker has disclosed a critical Docker Hub vulnerability that could let attackers impersonate other users and publish container images under trusted names. Tracked as CVE-2026-105445, the flaw affected personal access tokens transferred during account conversions. Docker resolved the issue on September 30, 2026, stating its investigation found no evidence of exploitation. This issue posed a […]

articles.title: Zoom Clients for Certificate Validation Flaw Exposes Sensitive Information via Network Access
articles.summary:
Two high-severity certificate validation flaws in Zoom clients could allow attackers without login credentials to access sensitive information over a network, according to advisory text dated October 13, 2026. The issues affect Windows clients and the My Notes feature across desktop and mobile platforms, making updates important for both personal users and business deployments. The […]

articles.summary:

articles.title: Danfoss Refrigeration Hack Update – 4,980 Hosts Found Exposed to Internet
articles.summary:
